name: Hepatitis C within-host dynamics under interferon-α therapy
description:
Hepatitis C virus within-host dynamics.
Structurally identical to the HIV target-cell model — the scientific content is in how therapy enters.
Parameter values: 0 of 10 checked against the source; the rest are recalled or illustrative.
reference: Neumann AU, Lam NP, Dahari H, Gretch DR, Wiley TE, Layden TJ, Perelson AS (1998). Hepatitis C viral dynamics in vivo and the antiviral efficacy of interferon-α therapy. Science 282(5386):103–107

compartments.name: V
compartments.description: free virions (IU or copies per mL)

parameters.name: dh
parameters.description: death rate of uninfected hepatocytes [illustrative] (per day)

parameters.name: delta
parameters.description: death/loss rate of infected hepatocytes; the authors estimated a wide range across patients (≈0.01–0.5 per day), corresponding to infected-cell half-lives of ≈1

parameters.name: p
parameters.description: virion production rate per infected cell [illustrative] (virions cell⁻¹ day⁻¹)

parameters.name: cV
parameters.description: virion clearance rate, implying a plasma virion half-life of ≈2.7 hours [unverified; 6.2/day is the headline estimate conventionally attributed to this paper] (

parameters.name: eta
parameters.description: interferon efficacy in blocking virion production (dimensionless, 0–1) [recalled]

parameters.name: eps
parameters.description: efficacy in blocking new infections (found to be the minor mechanism) [illustrative] (dimensionless, 0–1)

parameters.name: tau_lag
parameters.description: pharmacological delay before the drug acts (the authors needed a delay to fit the first hours) [illustrative] (days)
